mechanism_narrative: A higher level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) consistently indicates stronger labor market conditions, which support corporate earnings growth and drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The relationship holds without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: The correlation between PAYEMS and 20d forward returns is negative or not significant (p>0.05) over the entire sample period.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates elevated inflation, which typically leads to reduced corporate profit margins and higher real interest rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The relationship holds without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: The correlation between CPIAUCSL and 20d forward returns is positive or not significant (p>0.05) over the entire sample period.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 2.0% in a 3-month period, it signals a monetary tightening cycle, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS > 2.0% in 3 months, 20d forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the win rate is below 55%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a deteriorating labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE > 5.5% for two consecutive months, 20d forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the win rate is below 55%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) simultaneously rises by more than 0.3 percentage points in the same month, it signals an impending economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by > 0.5pp and UNRATE rises by > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS increases by >0.5pp and UNRATE rises by >0.3pp in 1 month, 20d forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the win rate is below 55%.

mechanism_narrative: When residential investment (HOUST) falls below 1000 thousand units and consumer credit (RSAFS) falls below 400,000 million dollars in the same month, it signals a contraction in the housing market and consumer credit, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 1000 and RSAFS < 400000 in the same month
failure_condition: In periods where HOUST < 1000 and RSAFS < 400000, 20d forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the win rate is below 55%.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion (defined by quarterly GDP growth above 3% and Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 240), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to overvaluation and increased risk of a market correction.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 3% and CPIAUCSL > 240 in the same quarter
failure_condition: In periods where GDPC1 growth > 3% and CPIAUCSL > 240, 60d forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the win rate is below 55%.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. The relationship holds without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: The correlation between INDPRO and 5d forward returns is negative or not significant (p>0.05) over the entire sample period.
